title: Hypertrophy
medium: Organic soya oil, shellac, pigment and linseed oil on paper

said.q: This work was created for the CCS Bard as part of a series of calendars for Calendar 2000, in which 184 artist's contributed an original work on paper to create 15 calendars whose proceeds supported the exhibition programs of the CCS Museum and Art for Art's Sake. This work was the month of August in the 13th calendar.
